description.html: A 40x25 cm floor has exactly 1000 cm², the height is 30 cm and the volume is 30 liters. It is 5 cm wider than the 40x20x30 model, which with a 3D background means noticeably more free floor. The dimensions are still small enough for a dresser or a desk.

A growing leopard gecko has room here for three hides and a shallow dish. A juvenile corn snake can stay until it is about half a meter long, and then it needs a longer terrarium. Young crested, gargoyle and day geckos use the 30 cm height and the relief of the background. Smaller lizard species get both a floor and a climbing wall.

Larger sizes with a similar ratio of sides are the 50x35x35 and 60x35x40. You choose the outer film from 34 patterns, and the background in the shape of rock or bark. We ship by courier to your address. If you need a size between these, we build it in 7 to 14 days.
